 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri S.M. Patel - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.
None for the victim despite service of notice.

Order 
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.405/2023, dated 01.11.2023 registered at Police Station-Naigarhi,
District-Mauganj (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n),
323 of IPC and Section 5/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Applicant is in detention since 02.11.2023. 2 .

As per the prosecution story, on 01.11.2023, 17 years old prosecutrix submitted an application in writing before the police alleging that she knew Sandeep Kushwaha (present applicant) since July, 2022.
They were having love affairs.

On 16.05.2023 at around 05:00 pm, Sandeep Kushawaha met 2 MCRC-27849-2024 her in Raipur Karchuriyan Market and took her in his house at village Chapgawan and thereafter, on false promise of marriage,
established physical relations with her.
Now, he has refused to enter into wedlock with her.
FIR was registered.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is in detention since 02.11.2023.
He has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.

It is contended by learned counsel for the applicant that prior to this incident, prosecutrix had also lodged FIR No.136/2023 dated 25.03.2023 registered at Police Station Raipur Karchuriyan and as per the documents of that case, she was recovered on 15.05.2023, therefore

, her contention that from Sandeep Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67624000/
1 16.05.2023 onwards, she was with the present applicant is false and fabricated allegation.

entities.text: Sandeep Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further contended that DNA report has been received and same is inconclusive.
Trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail, pending the trial.
4 . On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.

5 Having taken into consideration the submissions put-forth by learned counsel for the applicant and other facts & circumstances of the case including the fact that final conclusion of trial of the case will take considerable time, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

It is directed that applicant - Sandeep Kushwaha be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE @shish Sandeep Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67624000/
